description.narrative: FoodCloud, working in partnership with FoodBanking Kenya, will scale the use of Foodiverse to rescue and redistribute the equivalent of 7.82 million meals to 105 beneficiary agencies across 11 regions in Kenya by August 2026 which will result in saving over 1,760 tonnes of CO2-eq emissions from going to waste. Furthermore, this funding supports research, planning and the commencement of pilots in two additional African countries in collaboration with the Global Foodbanking Network. The project will result in a) the scaling up of a model for technology-led food distribution in Africa based on a locally-appropriate adaptation of FoodCloud’s existing model; b) the generation of evidence and impact data to support further expansion of the model into two additional African countries; c) increased food redistribution in Kenya, resulting in a reduction of GHG emissions and an increase in access to food for individuals in need; d) insights into the sustainability of FoodCloud’s commercial social enterprise model in Africa and assessment of opportunities for self-sustaining funding.
